Thanks for taking the time last week at HealthTech Summit — really enjoyed the product demo. As discussed, an ACE registration will make CloudMedics eligible for AWS co-sell and marketplace promotion, and I want to help get you through the intake quickly.

- Introduce you to the AWS PDM/PSM (I can loop them in once you confirm the registration).
- Book a 30-minute alignment call next week to cover go-to-market motions and marketplace listing timeline.

Are you available Wed 10/14 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 10/15 11:00–11:30 PT? If not, propose two times that work.

Karthik, Vanessa — adding you for technical and GTM context. Karthik, can you confirm whether we should use the standard ACE intake form or provide an expanded opportunity brief for PSM review?

Samir — I attached a short opportunity synopsis for AWS (one pager) and the ACE registration form filled with high-level info. Proposed meeting: Wed 10/14 10:00–10:30 PT (confirmed by Samir). If that slot works for Priya/PSM, great; otherwise propose alternate.

Attachments: CloudMedics_Opportunity_Synopsis.docx, ACE_Registration_Form.pdf

Notes for the call:
- High-level ARR estimate and three top use cases (triage automation, EHR extraction, post-discharge follow-up)
- Regulatory posture and data residency (CloudMedics hosts in us-east-1; will need to confirm logging/audit expectations)
- Marketplace listing timeline and co-sell resources required from AWS PSM

Thanks all — saw the synopsis and ACE form. We can accept the initial registration into ACE but need a co-sell case packet and expected ARR range before assigning a PSM to the opportunity.

Quick requests to move forward:
1) Karthik — please provide a 2–3 sentence ARR estimate (band: <$100k / $100k–$500k / >$500k) and the primary buyer persona.
2) Samir/Laura — confirm whether CloudMedics will require marketplace transactable listing or co-sell only (this affects timeline).
3) Attach any SOC2 or data-residency documentation if available; ops will need it for review.

I can tentatively hold a PSM for a short call next week once we have the ARR band and case packet. AWS marketplace portal link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/ticket/entry

—Priya Nair
Principal Partner Development Manager, AWS
